notes: All 306 fixtures come from the ESPN ger.1 scoreboard feed (Tier 2), read one date at a time for every date in the feed's 2026-27 calendar (56 dates, 28 Aug 2026 - 22 May 2027). Checks passed: 18 clubs, each 17 home and 17 away; every ordered pair exactly once; 9 matches and 18 different clubs in every matchday; matchday k+17 is matchday k with home and away swapped (k = 1-17).

Matchday numbers follow the date blocks (MD1 28-30 Aug ... MD11 27-29 Nov, then one date per matchday; MD16 Wed 13 Jan and MD24 Wed 3 Mar 2027 are midweek rounds). bundesliga.com's matchday pages (Tier 1) put every match of MD1-14 in the same matchday.

Kick-off times: ESPN times (timeValid) for MD1-11, which agree with bundesliga.com's matchday pages for MD8-11 (the pages show UTC to the reader; checked against bundesliga.com's 10 Sep 2026 article in CET); Hoffenheim v Augsburg (MD11) from bundesliga.com, Sun 29 Nov 16:30 UTC, where ESPN still had TBD. MD12-34 have one date per matchday in ESPN with time TBD (bundesliga.com: MD12-14 'not yet scheduled', 4-6, 11-13 and 18-20 Dec): stored on that Saturday (the Wednesday for MD16 and MD24) at 14:30 UTC, 13:30 UTC from 28 Mar 2027 (15:30 German time), with timeConfirmed false.
Results MD1-7 (63): ESPN and bundesliga.com (Tier 1) agree on every score, date and matchday; Sky Sports' October page agrees on MD5-7 (its August and September pages couldn't be opened).

Goals and half-time scores for all 63 results come from bundesliga.com's match pages (Tier 1; 224 goals: 8 penalties, 5 own goals; every list adds up to the final and half-time scores). ESPN's feed differs in 8 matches and was not used for those: one-minute differences in Bayern v Stuttgart (own goal 58', ESPN 57'), Leipzig v Gladbach (26'/25'), Hamburg v Köln (50'/49'), Bayern v Leipzig (53'/52'), Hoffenheim v Leverkusen (90+6'/90+5'); and who scored in Dortmund v Hamburg 45+1' (Konstantelias; ESPN: own goal Bornauw), Stuttgart v Köln 81' (own goal Hendriks; ESPN: Bülter), Frankfurt v Augsburg 46' (Ibrahimović; ESPN: own goal Baum). Elversberg v Augsburg 4': Petkov scored the rebound of his own saved penalty, recorded as a goal (the page doesn't count it as a penalty).
Conflict: MD8 Eintracht Frankfurt v Hamburger SV is Sun 1 Nov 16:30 UTC on bundesliga.com and ESPN, Sat 31 Oct on Sky Sports' October page: stored as bundesliga.com.

Table: points, goal difference, goals scored (DFL Spielordnung, section 2 no. 3 c; head-to-head counts only once both meetings are played) = points-gd-gf. Zones: Champions League 1-4, Europa League 5, Conference League 6 (simplified, as for the Premier League), relegation play-off 16th (two legs against the 2. Bundesliga's third), relegation 17th-18th (DFL Spielordnung, section 3 no. 2; bundesliga.com FAQ).

ESPN quirks: odd venue cities (Signal Iduna Park in 'Aue', Volksparkstadion in 'Hamburg Norderstedt'); 'neutral' always null; a date with more than about 7 finished matches is cut off by the reader (read the missing matches one by one with .../scoreboard/<event id>).
